<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X) / 2. For C13H19OS, C = 13, H = 19, N = 0, X = 0 (halogens). Oxygen and sulfur do not affect the calculation. DBE = (2·13 + 2 – 19) / 2 = (28 – 19) / 2 = 9 / 2 = 4.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the nearest whole‑number value is 4.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
